fermion_process: generate e+ e- > x1+ x1- / z sve sve~, (x1+ > mu+ svm), (x1- > mu- svm~)
vector_process: generate e+ e- > w+ w- / z ve ve~, (w+ > mu+ vm), (w- > mu- vm~)
production_restriction: photon s-channel only; Z and t-channel exchange excluded
vector_note: W-like benchmark only. MZ/GF are auxiliary inputs chosen so the pinned SM tree-level internal MW equals the matched parent mass. Z and neutrino t-channel production are excluded, so only the SM photon-vector vertex controls production.
